# Perplexity AI

Perplexity AI provides conversational AI models for generating human-like text responses

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/perplexityai/.

## Actions

- **PerplexityAISearch** (read-only): Perplexity ai search interfaces with perplexity ai to perform search queries and return responses from a range of models.
